summary: Delta Air Lines filed an 8-K reporting completion of a $500 million public offering of 5.500% senior unsecured notes due November 6, 2029, issued under a base indenture dated March 6, 2017, as supplemented by a Seventh Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. Interest pays semi-annually beginning May 6, 2027. The notes rank pari passu with other unsubordinated debt. Net proceeds are partly earmarked to repay roughly $391 million of Payroll Support Program borrowings. This is a routine investment-grade-style debt takedown off an automatic shelf, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
